arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
echo '--- WARM_RESIDENCY_CALLERS ---'
find "$BASE" -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.env' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.conf' \) \
 ! -path "$BASE/envs/*" ! -path "$BASE/miniconda/*" ! -path "$BASE/openwebui-data/*" ! -path "$BASE/.ollama/*" ! -path "$BASE/backups/*" ! -path "$BASE/checkpoints/*" \
 -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 grep -nH -E 'warm-residency\.sh|qwen2\.5-coder:1\.5b-instruct-q4_K_M|keep_alive.?[:=].?-1' 2>/dev/null | head -300 || true
echo '--- CRONTAB ---'
crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- RUNTIME_AUTOMATION_DIR ---'
find "$BASE/runtime-domains/automation" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p size=%s mtime=%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
echo '--- TOPLEVEL_OLLAMA_FILES ---'
find "$BASE" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*ollama*' -o -iname '*residen*' -o -iname '*warm*' \) -printf '%p size=%s mtime=%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
